notes: INSIDE half of the Basalt Magma Spitter: a stone crucible whose magma level rises with the charge (frame 5 = brim full and white-hot, strip yellow), power coupling in an iron socket, stone repair hatch, five magma slits. fire: the crucible flashes white and drains. damaged: the crucible rim cracked and weeping magma, two slits dead, a drip; disabled: cold crust in the pot, the rim split, a chunk fallen. Barrel layer basalt_magma_spitter_barrel: a thick stone tube flaring into a volcano mouth full of glowing slag; fire: a glob of slag leaves the mouth. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
